SELECT * FROM ASSET WHERE IS_DELETED = 'N'
AND LOWER(NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{q}) || '%'
AND STATUS = 'AVAILABLE'
ORDER BY ASSET_ID

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET WHERE IS_DELETED = 'N'
AND LOWER(NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{q}) || '%'
AND STATUS = 'AVAILABLE'

SELECT MIN(a.ASSET_ID) AS ASSET_ID, a.NAME, a.CATEGORY, a.COMPANY,
CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN a.STATUS = 'AVAILABLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE MIN(a.STATUS) END AS STATUS, MIN(a.IMAGE) AS IMAGE, MIN(a.MAINTENANCE_CYCLE) AS MAINTENANCE_CYCLE, MIN(a.USAGE_TIME) AS USAGE_TIME, MIN(a.LAST_MAINTENANCE_DATE) AS LAST_MAINTENANCE_DATE, MIN(a.EXPECTED_MAINTENANCE_DATE) AS EXPECTED_MAINTENANCE_DATE, MIN(a.CREATED_AT) AS CREATED_AT, MIN(a.UPDATED_AT) AS UPDATED_AT, MIN(a.DELETED_AT) AS DELETED_AT, MIN(CASE WHEN a.IS_DELETED = 'N' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS IS_DELETED, COUNT(a.ASSET_ID) AS STOCK, SUM(CASE WHEN a.STATUS = 'AVAILABLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS AVAILABLE_STOCK, SUM(CASE WHEN a.STATUS IN ('USING', 'MAINTENANCE_REQUIRED', 'MAINTAINING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS RENTED_STOCK FROM ASSET a WHERE a.IS_DELETED = 'N'
AND LOWER(a.NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{q}) || '%'
GROUP BY a.NAME, a.CATEGORY, a.COMPANY
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN a.STATUS = 'AVAILABLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY a.NAME, a.CATEGORY, a.COMPANY
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT a.NAME, a.CATEGORY, a.COMPANY FROM ASSET a WHERE a.IS_DELETED = 'N'
AND LOWER(a.NAME) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{q}) || '%'
GROUP BY a.NAME, a.CATEGORY, a.COMPANY
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN a.STATUS = 'AVAILABLE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET WHERE IS_DELETED = 'N' AND NAME = #{name} AND (CATEGORY = #{category} OR (CATEGORY IS NULL AND #{category} IS NULL)) AND (COMPANY = #{company} OR (COMPANY IS NULL AND #{company} IS NULL))

SELECT a.* FROM ASSET a WHERE a.IS_DELETED = 'N' AND a.NAME = #{name} AND (a.CATEGORY = #{category} OR (a.CATEGORY IS NULL AND #{category} IS NULL)) AND (a.COMPANY = #{company} OR (a.COMPANY IS NULL AND #{company} IS NULL)) AND a.STATUS = 'AVAILABLE' ORDER BY a.ASSET_ID
